applicability: The Intent Reviewer surface (ReviewSurface) when the reader selects a family, an invariant or the whole task after the task context has at least one admitted review payload.
conditions: An admitted frame exists for the same repository, task, leaf and record.
The requested reading status lasts only while that subject's read is pending; answers and failures use their own bound content.
The removed SourceExplorer is not in the mounted set; source inventory opens in the existing comparison viewer.
exclusions: The reviewer's first read, which has no frame and is stated at the surface level.
A different leaf or record, whose frame is never reused.
Server-side read latency of a first visit to a subject.
The removed source explorer in the mounted set.
statement: Selecting a family, invariant or task preserves the mounted review workspace, compact navigation and tree, plus retained open inspection state. During the selected-subject read, only the reading area changes to the requested-question pending state and navigation stays usable.
